title.value: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: GrowSpace: Learning How to Shape Plants

extractions.description: This paper introduces GrowSpace, a new Reinforcement Learning (RL) benchmark environment for controlling plant growth through light manipulation. It addresses challenges in control, hierarchical learning, fairness, and multi-objective learning, spanning plant science, agriculture, RL, and robotics.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper directly relates to optimizing plant growth, which is essential for sustainable agriculture and food security.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Plants are dynamic systems that are integral to our existence and survival.

primary_category.justification: The research focuses on optimizing plant growth, which can enhance carbon sequestration.
primary_category.quote: With the objective of controlling a plant by moving the light source, we propose GrowSpace, as a new RL benchmark

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper explores methods for controlling and optimizing plant growth, directly applicable to agricultural practices.
primary_sub_category.quote: GrowSpace is an environment that spans across different fields such as plant science, agriculture, RL, and robotics
